newsitem.title: USA: Vivax Medical Corp Q1 net loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Vivax Medical Corp Q1 net loss widens.

text.p: NOTE: (1) Proforma statements of operations and balance sheet highlights for the period ended March 31 1997 includes the operations of Concept Medical Corporation, which VIVAX has agreed to purchase. In May 1997, the Company entered into an agreement to purchase all of the outstanding stock of Concept Medical Corporation and Affiliates. The closing is scheduled for on or about June 30 1997. Completion of the acquisition is subject to the execution of a definitive agreement.
(2) Consolidated statements of operations and balance sheet highlights for the period ended March 31, 1997 includes the operations of Vivax Medical Northeast Corp, which was acquired in June 1996.
